name: Local code & GitHub code
operations: Index and query selected code, inspect Git history, apply bounded changes.
configuration: Exact source paths and Git scope; authenticated access for private remote resources.
limitation: Local dirty bytes and committed Git blobs remain separate. Language and parser coverage varies.

name: Word
operations: Read, generate, edit, render and export selected documents.
configuration: Selected DOCX files and the operation’s required renderer or converter.
limitation: Conversion and rendering fidelity depend on format, fonts and the selected tool.

name: PowerPoint
operations: Read, generate, edit, render and export presentations.
configuration: Selected PPTX sources and required presentation tools.
limitation: Embedded objects and animation fidelity need representative output checks.

name: Excel
operations: Read workbook structure and values; edit, recalculate, render and export.
configuration: Exact workbook, intended operations and required calculation tools.
limitation: Stored values and recalculated results differ. Formula support follows the chosen backend.

name: Structured data
operations: Inspect, transform and export selected structured datasets.
configuration: Bounded files and a selected DuckDB, pandas, Polars or Arrow route.
limitation: Sampling, query limits and datatype coverage must remain visible.

name: Tableau
operations: Index, query, generate, edit and export supported Tableau material.
configuration: Exact source format and registered Tableau/Hyper tool route.
limitation: Format-specific operations do not imply a live Tableau Server connection or universal workbook fidelity.

name: Power BI
operations: Inspect supported Power BI structures and execute format-specific changes.
configuration: Selected format and the required TOM or PBIX helper runtime.
limitation: Local file support does not imply access to Power BI Service or every visual’s rendering behavior.

name: PDF & OCR
operations: Read, render, enrich and extract text from selected PDFs.
configuration: Page bounds, OCR model/runtime and an operation-specific tool route.
limitation: OCR accuracy varies by image quality and language. Optional licensed tools need their own grant.

name: Images & media
operations: Index, extract, OCR, transform and export selected media.
configuration: Selected files, codec/model needs and measured local tool readiness.
limitation: Supported codecs and extraction coverage are specific to the selected tools.

name: Research & web
operations: Discover, capture, extract and query attributed web sources.
configuration: Explicit URL/network scope and configured services when required.
limitation: Network availability, site restrictions and changing pages affect coverage.

name: Artifacts
operations: Register and query generated or selected project artifacts.
configuration: Exact artifact files and their source/result ownership.
limitation: An artifact’s presence is not verification of its claims.

name: Custom sources & selected SQLite
operations: Configure multiple custom source instances and inspect bounded selected data.
configuration: Explicit source identity, schema mapping and read bounds.
limitation: Selected SQLite reading is not Microsoft Access import or permission to merge project stores.
